label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF PATRICK MICHAEL MEGARO
text: Patrick Michael Megaro, of Oviedo, Florida, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of August 22, 2022; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Patrick Michael Megaro is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.

label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF HARVEY BRUCE BRUNER
text: Harvey Bruce Bruner, of Cleveland, Ohio, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of December 5, 2022; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Harvey Bruce Bruner is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
